# Using GPU Spaces

| Hardware          | CPU    | Memory | GPU Memory | Disk  | Hourly Price |
| ----------------- | ------ | ------ | ---------- | ----- | ------------ |
| CPU Basic         | 2 vCPU | 16 GB  | -          | 50 GB | Free!        |
| CPU Upgrade       | 8 vCPU | 32 GB  | -          | 50 GB | $0.03        |
| Nvidia T4 - small | 4 vCPU | 15 GB  | 16 GB      | 50 GB | $0.40        |

Billing on Spaces is based on hardware usage and is computed by the minute. A Space is billed only while Starting or Running; build and sleep time are not billed. Each replica is billed independently.
